shots.action: He poses and grins beside the car; she gives a polite small smile and shifts her bag.
He tosses the card toward the waiter with a flick and laughs; she glances at the wine bottle.
They both laugh over the simple meal; steam rises from the pot.
She hands over the card with a happy smile; he smiles back warmly.
She reads the phone, frowns slightly and lowers it to her lap.
He grips his hair and stares at the bills with a heavy sigh.
He points calmly at the open notebook while explaining; she leans in and listens.
Her worried look softens into a warm, reassured smile; one slow blink.
They walk slowly hand in hand toward the sunset; leaves sway gently.
